_comment: PHASE L4. Bucket key -> a slug that already exists in the source icon set.
NO NEW ART. Every value here names a drawing Arcticons already ships, so
the category tier costs 26 extra entries in one base pack and inherits
through all fourteen derived packs with their own tint, for free.
The slugs below are a first pass and some will not exist under these exact
names. build-vector-pack.mjs reports every miss by name rather than
skipping it quietly: a bucket with no drawing classifies correctly,
resolves to nothing and falls to the generator, which is a right answer
with no picture and no error. Fix the misses here, not in the builder.
Keys must match AppCategoryBucket.key in CategoryIndex.kt exactly.
